description: This file defines a mock chat service for testing and offline use in a Flutter application, implementing the ChatService interface with deterministic responses for simulating multi-turn chat interactions.

classes.name: MockChatService
classes.description: A deterministic offline mock implementation of ChatService that simulates a multi-turn chat flow for testing and UI preview purposes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the mock service to its initial state (turn 0).

methods.name: _extractTag
methods.description: Extracts the content within specified XML-like tags from a text string.

methods.name: _buildOfflineFinalAnswer
methods.description: Constructs a deterministic final answer string based on the user's question and observation.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a message and returns a deterministic response mimicking an agent's reasoning process.
